subject: general
question:
A circular hole of radius 3 cm is cut from a rectangular sheet of dimensions 12 cm × 10 cm. Find the remaining area.

(Take π = 3.14)
solution:
The correct answer is __91.74 cm²__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Area of the rectangular sheet:__ 12 cm × 10 cm = 120 cm².
 
• __Area of the circular hole:__ πr² = 3.14 × (3)² = 28.26 cm².
 
• __Remaining area:__ 120 cm² - 28.26 cm² = 91.74 cm².
